statements.statement: The service billed was mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229)
The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptoms
The telemetry is intended to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management
The denial reason code is CO-22
The current denial is for coordination of benefits
The clinical facts support the medical necessity of the service
Another insurer's coverage responsibility is not established by the clinical facts
